purpose: Plan future source collection for high-rise humanitarian vertical evacuation candidate screening without performing large downloads or scraping in P5-F.

collectionPolicy.notes: P5-F records source families and future collection requirements only. Real collection must be a later reviewed task.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Extract height, floors above ground, usage, footprint area, and PLATEAU building identifiers where available.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Use existing local PLATEAU data or processed subsets under an approved later task.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Preserve official/designated evacuation facility records from P5-B/P5-C outputs and keep them separate from humanitarian candidates.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Reuse existing processed outputs when approved; do not change Unity runtime source mode.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Collect Chuo/Tokyo disaster prevention, evacuation building, hazard map, and agreement information when source review permits.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Manual official-source review and controlled download only.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Capture seismic diagnosis, retrofit, construction era, or structural safety hints where public and lawful to use.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Manual review and small controlled source registry before automated ingestion.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Supplement PLATEAU attributes with public height, floor count, use, and capacity proxy information if available.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Manual source review first; avoid broad scraping.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Estimate route distance/time and compare candidate coverage against official shelter access gaps.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Reuse approved P5 routing methods only as prototype estimates; official route claims require official evidence.

sourceFamilies.futureUse: Track public access, management agreement, seismic uncertainty, source conflict, and field verification needs.
sourceFamilies.collectionMode: Human-maintained review queue; no automatic public claim.

futureValidationRequirements: Every official_confirmed or official_confirmed_with_review record must cite official evidence.
Every humanitarian candidate must state that it is not an official shelter.
Unknown public access must trigger manual review but must not automatically exclude a candidate.
Unknown seismic evidence must trigger manual review.
Prototype route fields must not be labeled as official evacuation routes.
Raw/cache/download/tmp/.venv and large GIS data must stay uncommitted.
nextActions: Run DeepSeek review on P5-F data/schema/rulebook boundaries.
After review, design a small controlled Chuo high-rise extraction task using local PLATEAU attributes only.
Add manual review workflow for access, management agreement, and seismic evidence.
Only after source review, decide whether small official-source updates are needed.
